description: This file defines the Image_Canvas_SVG class for generating SVG graphics, including methods for drawing shapes, text, images, and managing SVG elements and definitions.

classes.name: Image_Canvas_SVG
classes.description: A class for creating and rendering SVG format graphics, extending the Image_Canvas base class.

methods.name: Image_Canvas_SVG
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SVG canvas with given parameters.

methods.name: _addElement
methods.description: Adds an SVG element string to the internal elements collection, optionally wrapping with a link if URL parameters are provided.

methods.name: _addDefine
methods.description: Adds a definition (like gradients or clip paths) to the SVG definitions collection.

methods.name: _color
methods.description: Converts a color value to an SVG-compatible RGB string.

methods.name: _opacity
methods.description: Calculates the opacity value for a color for SVG.

methods.name: _getLineStyle
methods.description: Generates SVG style string for line styles based on current settings.

methods.name: _getFillStyle
methods.description: Generates SVG fill style string, including support for gradients.

methods.name: setFillImage
methods.description: Placeholder for setting a fill image (not implemented).

methods.name: setGradientFill
methods.description: Sets a gradient fill style for subsequent shapes.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Sets font options for text rendering, ensuring a default size if not specified.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line between two points with optional color.

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon or polyline with optional fill and stroke colors.

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle with specified corner points and optional fill and stroke.

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse with specified center and radii.

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Draws a pie slice or full ellipse based on angles.

methods.name: textWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a text string based on font size.

methods.name: textHeight
methods.description: Calculates the height of a text string based on font size.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Adds text at specified position with alignment and color options.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Overlays an image from a file, encoding it as base64 data URI.

methods.name: startGroup
methods.description: Starts an SVG group with an optional name, managing group IDs.

methods.name: endGroup
methods.description: Ends the current SVG group.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Outputs the complete SVG document to the browser.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the SVG document to a specified filename.

methods.name: setClipping
methods.description: Defines or removes a clipping path for subsequent drawing.

methods.name: toHtml
methods.description: Returns an HTML embed tag for displaying the SVG as an embedded object.
